lane: GPU 1: SSL with strong, domain-specific views (plan row G2)
plan: docs/PLAN_20261106.md, row G2, measurement rule as written there
tests_belief: 1 (SSL at its ceiling, SSL5 suffices). SSL5 views differ only by flips and small gain and offset, the SSL pools by mean while the regression pools by std, and only duration and seed were ever varied.

baseline_calibration.what: Frozen read of existing encoders, no gate: external CPDINO, SSL5, SSL10, SSL20 on fold 4; external, SSL5 on fold 0; recipe A tuned encoders (std, seed 46, epoch 20) on folds 0 and 4.
baseline_calibration.question: How much of a frozen delta survives fine-tuning. Compare to end-to-end on fold 4 with mean pooling: SSL0 9.1468, SSL5 9.1333, SSL10 9.1113, SSL20 9.1200.

result_before_any_arm_ran.reading: Frozen spread is 0.33 on mean pooling, end-to-end spread 0.035, and SSL10 and SSL20 reverse sign. Fine-tuning erases most of a frozen difference, so a frozen delta ranks starting points only. Passing the frozen screen is necessary evidence for spending a 20 h end-to-end run, not evidence of gain. Gates unchanged.

frozen_read.features: Encoder forward on all frames as at inference: CLAHE, percentile, replicate pad, whole frame, one unflipped view; mean and std of patch tokens. Checkpoint of the arm's last epoch.
frozen_read.model: Ridge on z-scored features, standardised log targets, lambda per metric from a donor-grouped inner 5-fold on train rows only. Train rows from the fold's split file, scored on the fold's validation rows of the OOF table.
frozen_read.primary_pool: std, the regression's pooling. Also reported: mean, both.
frozen_read.reference: SSL5 of the same fold, same read.

views.ssl5: Whole frame, flips, gain 0.9-1.1, offset +-0.03 after CLAHE.
views.crop: Square crop, side 544 px (about 200 cells, near the technician's region), native scale, cut after CLAHE so tile geometry matches inference; four rotations, flips, the same gain and offset. Two views of a frame are independent crops. RoPE keeps the whole-frame grid scale.
views.optics: Before CLAHE, per view: gamma exp(+-0.25), gain log SD 0.25, illumination field exp(-v r2 + tilt), v in -0.2 to 0.8, tilt +-0.25, Gaussian blur sigma 0.4-2.0 px at p 0.5, signal-dependent Gaussian noise SD up to 8 gray levels at p 0.8, 99th percentile held under 250. Ranges from lane GPU 0's frame_stats.npz over all labelled frames.
views.risk_written_before_running: Source identification carries about half of the all-rows CV correlation. A view set that removes exposure and illumination may remove that signal too. Read CV per metric, not only the mean.

stage_1_fold_4.common: Same LeJEPA math, optimiser, LR 1e-5, projector, lambda 0.02, batch 32 frames, seed 1003, 5 epochs, train rows of the fold only, external CPDINO start.
stage_1_fold_4.cropopt_both_f4: crop + optics, mean and std concatenated

arms.stage_2: Best two arms of stage 1 by primary read, on fold 0, chosen on fold 4 only. Then, chosen on the two-fold read: longer SSL (20 epochs), encoder LR 3e-5, 4 views, whole-frame optics.
arms.stage_3: End-to-end recipe A regression from the arm's encoder on folds 0 and 4: frozen std runner, seed 46, 20 epochs, schedule 10, one GPU through lane GPU 0's wrapper, 10 h per fold.

gates.screen_for_end_to_end: Frozen read, two-fold pooled delta against SSL5 <= -0.03, CI below 0, both folds negative, on the primary pool. Same screen as lane GPU 2. If nothing passes by the 11-08 read, run end-to-end for the best arm once anyway to test whether the frozen read predicts the end-to-end result, and say so in the report.
gates.pass_new_member: As the plan: end-to-end two-fold mean of the last five epochs <= -0.05 with CI below 0 against the same-seed recipe A, or added to the best pipeline <= -0.02 with CI below 0, w fixed at 0.25 and 0.125.
gates.seed_noise: Before any arm is called better on the frozen read alone, one arm is rerun with SSL seed 1004 on the same fold, and the delta must exceed the difference between seeds.

records: Reads in reads/, results in REPORT.md, queue in queue.tsv and done.tsv.
promotion: Never automatic. No commits and no submissions from this lane.

amendments.seen_before_writing: Fold 4 frozen reads of the five stage 1 arms; nothing on fold 0.
amendments.stage_2_order: cropopt_both and cropopt_mean (best two on fold 4 std read, -0.166 and -0.159) on fold 0. cropopt_std (-0.157) is a tie with cropopt_mean and is not run on fold 0 unless the read needs it.
amendments.optics_correction: Lane GPU 0's calibrated measurements came after these views were set: noise above about sigma 4.3 and blur without refill leave the real range. So the arm name 'measured' overstates it: these are broad optics views. New arm cropxfer_both_f4 uses lane GPU 0's calibrated donor transfer as the view, same crop and pooling.
amendments.end_to_end: cropopt_both end to end on folds 4 and 0 is queued now, because the screen fallback requires one end-to-end run of the best arm in any case and the frozen read cannot show the gain. If fold 0 reverses the choice, the queue changes before the job starts.
amendments.second_stream: Short SSL arms run next to the long job on GPU 1: 143 GB memory, same total work, reads sooner. Frozen reads are not timed, so sharing does not touch them. End-to-end reads are not affected except in wall time.

amendments.from: Coordinating session, on GPU allocation only. No gate changes.
amendments.order: cropopt_both_f0, then end to end of cropopt_both_f4 on GPU 1. End to end of cropopt_both_f0 moves to GPU 3 with this lane as the encoder source. After that: same SSL recipe on folds 1, 3, 2 and all data, encoder only, for promotion if the gate passes. Then cropopt_mean_f0, seed 1004, calibrated transfer, encoder LR 3e-5, 20 epochs.
amendments.short_stream: Emptied, because two jobs on one GPU share compute and the end-to-end run has priority. Stopped jobs: seed 1004 at about 8 min, transfer at 33 s; both requeued in the main queue, seed under the name cropopt_both_seed1004_f4. Empty folders ssl/cropopt_both_s1004_f4 remain.
amendments.pairing: Promotion encoders are trained before the gate is read, so that a pass does not wait. They do not change the read.

amendments.seen_before_writing: The verdict above. No token read.
amendments.why: The strong-view encoder is label-free and did not help as a starting point. Its other possible use is what the audit calls belief 14: SSL5 tokens at graph nodes memorised (32 dims +0.165, +0.144; 8 dims +0.041), with one token source and no regulariser.

arms.tk_crop8: cropopt_both_f4 encoder tokens at nodes, 8 PCA dims
arms.tk_crop8_reg: crop tokens, 8 dims, dropout 0.3, weight decay 0.1

amendments.common: cell_graph_sweep3, pre-only detector s48 graphs, d 64, 5 layers, no context, 25 epochs, 3 seeds, five folds. The encoder saw no labels, and fold 4 encoder reads frames of all folds; a pass would be repeated with fold-clean encoders.
amendments.reference: d64_l5_pre48_s3, same graphs and config, geometry only.
amendments.gate: As the plan for corrections: <= -0.01 on the mean against the reference, CI below 0, 4 of 5 folds, CV and HEX only as in the best pipeline.
amendments.queue: Fold 1 SSL stopped at about epoch 2; promotion SSL moved to the tail because promotion does not start. Frozen arms stay queued as filler, low value because the frozen read does not predict end to end.

end_to_end_verdict.second_seed: Fold 4 seed 47 alone: +0.0032 (CI -0.0462, +0.055). Fold 0 seed 47 on GPU 2 not finished.
end_to_end_verdict.result: Fails both pass rules. Promotion does not start.
end_to_end_verdict.belief_1: A much stronger SSL by the frozen read (-0.182) gives no end-to-end gain. Fine-tuning lands on the recipe A solution: residual r with the reference 0.98-0.99 on fold 0.
